title: 第21章 真仙境前往花果山前的准备第22章 神通小成好强的逼气
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 此刻。
万岁狐王看到自家女儿出现，没好气道：
“你又去哪里疯了，都跟你说了很多次，外面危险的很。”
玉面公主涉世未深，根本不知道这外面的水有多深。
但万岁狐王知道，这西牛贺州看似是妖怪的天堂，可以无法无天。
但背后真正的主人却是那灵山佛门，以及监察三界，高高在上的天庭。
若是得罪了这两尊庞然大物，成为坐骑都是幸运的。
大部分都是化为劫灰，魂归地府。
万岁狐王自然是怕女儿惹到这两尊庞然大物。
到时候即便是他，也无能为力。
万岁狐王的担心不无道理，原作里，玉面公主不就是招惹到了天庭和佛门这两个大势力，最终才香消玉殒的。
“好了，好了，我知道了，父亲，每次你都说一遍。”
玉面公主一脸嘻嘻哈哈。
将万岁狐王哄好后，她便把遇到叶云，以及拜托其炼制寿元丹的事情一股脑说了出来。
末了，玉面公主赞叹道：“父亲，你是没看到，那黄风大王用铁锅炼丹，还炼制出了一手好丹，简直叹为观止。”
“黄风大王，没想到妖界竟出现这样一位妖王。”
万岁狐王自然是不怀疑女儿的话，毕竟玉面公主虽然涉世未深，但在他的教导下，见识还是有的。
让他没想到的是，在黄风岭这样名不见经传的地方，出现了一位擅长炼丹的黄风大王。
妖怪会炼丹，本来就少之又少，何况还是水平这么高的。
万岁狐王之前请来的基本上都是人族炼丹师，还是颇有名声那种，水平也不差。
但从自家女儿描述来看，远远不及这位黄风大王。
一时之间，万岁狐王原本沉寂的心思，再度活跃起来。
毕竟，若是能活，谁想就这么死去呢。
当即，万岁狐王对着玉面公主道：“既然这样，那我们立刻带着炼制寿元丹的材料前去黄风岭。”
玉面公主却道：“父亲，那黄风大王待在那小小的黄风岭，肯定是喜静，不愿被打扰，还是由我去吧。”
“嗯，是我考虑不周了，那就女儿你去吧，记得多带些宝物前去，不管成功与否，都不可轻慢。”
万岁狐王都是老油条了，知道如黄风大王这样炼丹大佬的稀缺性，即便失败了也要结交。
玉面公主没有犹豫，立刻下去准备炼制寿元丹的材料以及宝物。
另一边。
叶云用黑风山收来的天材地宝，以及玉面公主送的天材地宝，不断炼制出一颗颗丹药。
服用炼化之后，太白剑经的进度点也在蹭蹭的往上涨着。
十天之后，这批丹药快被消耗殆尽之时，太白剑经的进度，终于突破了精通，达到了小成层次。
【太白剑经（小成136万）】
这也意味着，叶云的境界突破了天仙巅峰，晋升，真仙初期！
霎时间，叶云感觉自身又迎来了一次大蜕变。
明悟天地真义，可动天地之力，体内法力浩瀚如星河，元神遨游寰宇周天……
得来长生天地寿，无尽乾坤存我身！
“真仙，又是一种全新的感觉。”
叶云负手而立，脸上的喜悦隐藏不住。
到了此时，他才算是真正跨过了仙道新手期。
content_en:
now.
Long Live the Fox King saw his daughter appearing and said angrily:
"Where are you going crazy? I've told you many times that it's very dangerous outside."
Princess Jade Face is new to the world and has no idea how deep the water outside is.
But Long Live the Fox King knows that Xiniu Hezhou seems to be a paradise for monsters and can be lawless.
But the real master behind it is the Lingshan Buddhist Sect and the heavenly court that oversees the three realms.
If you offend these two behemoths, you will be lucky to become a mount.
Most of them were turned into ashes and their souls returned to the underworld.
The Long Live Fox King was naturally afraid that his daughter would offend these two behemoths.
Even he will be unable to do anything by then.
Long live the Fox King's worries are not unreasonable. In the original work, the Jade-faced Princess provoked the two major forces of Heaven and Buddhism, and finally died.
"Okay, okay, I understand, father, you say it again every time."
The jade-faced princess was laughing and joking.
After coaxing the Long Live Fox King, she told him everything about meeting Ye Yun and asking him to refine the longevity pill.
At the end, Princess Jade Face exclaimed: "Father, you haven't seen that King Huang Feng used an iron pot to refine elixirs and also made a good elixir. It's simply amazing."
"King Huang Feng, I never expected that such a demon king would appear in the demon world."
The Long Live Fox King naturally did not doubt his daughter's words. After all, although Princess Jade Face was not deeply involved in the world, she still had some knowledge under his guidance.
What he didn't expect was that in a little-known place like Huangfengling, a King Huangfeng who was good at alchemy would appear.
There are very few monsters who can make elixirs, let alone at such a high level.
The people that the Long Live Fox King had previously invited were basically human alchemists, the kind that were quite famous, and their skills were not bad.
But judging from his daughter's description, she is far inferior to the Yellow Wind King.
Suddenly, Long Live Fox King's originally silent mind became active again.
After all, if you can live, who wants to die like this.
Immediately, the Long Live Fox King said to Princess Jade Face: "In this case, let's go to Huangfengling immediately with the materials for refining the Shou Yuan Dan."
Princess Jade Face said: "Father, King Huangfeng must be staying in that small Huangfengling. He must be quiet and doesn't want to be disturbed. It's better for me to go."
"Well, I didn't think carefully. Then, my daughter, go ahead. Remember to bring more treasures. No matter whether you succeed or not, don't be scornful."
The Long Live Fox King is a veteran, and knows the scarcity of alchemy masters like King Huangfeng, so he still wants to make friends even if he fails.
"Okay."
Princess Jade Face did not hesitate and immediately went down to prepare the materials and treasures for refining the Shou Yuan Dan.
…
other side.
Ye Yun used the heavenly materials and earthly treasures collected from Black Wind Mountain and the heavenly materials and earthly treasures given by Princess Jade Face to continuously refine pills.
After taking the refining, the progress points of Taibai Sword Sutra are also rising slowly.
Ten days later, when the batch of elixirs was almost exhausted, the progress of Taibai Sword Sutra finally broke through the mastery level and reached the level of minor success.
[Taibai Sword Classic (Xiaocheng 1.36 million)]
This also means that Ye Yun's realm has broken through the peak of Tianxian, and has been promoted to the early stage of True Immortal!
In an instant, Ye Yun felt that he had undergone another major transformation.
If you clearly understand the true meaning of heaven and earth, you can use the power of heaven and earth. The magic power in your body is as vast as the galaxy, and your soul can travel around the world...
May I live forever, and may the endless universe exist within me!
"True immortal, it's a whole new feeling."
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, unable to hide the joy on his face.
At this time, he had truly passed through the novice stage of immortality.
